### Jesus Help me and to God be the Glory
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-june-27-2008-11578250.html
Passage: Psalm 54:4
Points:
- Composer J. S. Bach opened compositions by asking Jesus for help and concluded them by giving God the glory.
- Even the most gifted and capable individuals must guard against self-reliance.
- Believers remain utterly dependent upon the Lord for sustaining help in daily tasks.
- Intentionally starting with prayer and ending with thanksgiving maintains proper humility before God.

### Rest in God's Faithfulness
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-july-23-2013.html
Passage: Psalm 54:6
Points:
- Biblical surrender is not admitting defeat to an enemy, but trusting our divine ally.
- David overcame bitterness and retaliation by committing his demand for justice into God's hands.
- Faith does not ignore mistreatment, but chooses to focus on God's faithfulness rather than an opponent's wrongdoing.
- Turning from worry to voluntary praise brings tranquility even before hostile circumstances change.
